_doc: Blitz paths and outcomes (play/blitz.ts). Per defense call: which non-linemen blitz, along which path, after which delay (s). Paths: edge (wide arc around the tackle), aGap / bGap (through the line next to the center / guard), delayed (wait, then the A gap). Who can pick a blitzer up: blocking.json protection.olReach / backReach. hurryRadius: an unblocked rusher this close to the QB at the release hurries the throw. recognize: chance per path that the protection identifies the blitzer at the snap (scaled by the line's awareness, recognizeAwareness = weight); an unidentified blitzer comes free.

surprise._doc: Phase 3c: rushers the protection did not plan for: a defender the call did not send (the user's LB blitzing in Cover 3) or a designed blitzer the line did not identify. A non-lineman counts as rushing once he is within maxDepth yd of the LOS (or behind it), within range yd of the QB and closing on him at minClosing yd/s or more. The line treats him as a rusher (pickup by any free blocker) after lineReact s, the QB notices him after qbReact s (blindExtra more when he comes from outside the QB's field of view, blindAngle deg), both scaled by awarenessRef / awareness. After that the QB is alerted: pressure counts the rusher by how he is actually blocked, and the most open receiver is the hot read.
